title: The Bible, Douay-Rheims, Book 02: Exodus
subtitle: The Challoner Revision
description: "The Bible, Douay-Rheims, Book 02: Exodus" is the second book of the Bible, traditionally dated to the fifth through fourth centuries BC. It narrates the origin story of the Israelites as they escape slavery in Egypt through divine intervention. The journey leads them to Mount Sinai, where they receive the Law and enter into a covenant with God. The text details instructions for building the Tabernacle and establishes the identity and laws of a people chosen to become a holy nation.
